title: Latvia calls out Russia's chemical weapons violations
summary_full: On 23rd November 2026, at the 31st Session of the Conference of the States Parties to the Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) in The Hague (Netherlands), Latvia and Montenegro were confirmed as Vice-Chairs to the Conference, representing the Eastern European Group.
